page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support external data transfers and multi-node communication. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants on the physical host.

The balanced resource profile of the ecs.g9ae.16xlarge makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring a steady ratio of compute power to memory. It is suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, middle-tier application servers, containerized microservices, and moderate database workloads that do not demand local SSD performance or GPU acceleration.
